Product: ContractIQ
Target: legal teams at mid-size companies
Problem: Contract review takes 3-5 days per agreement; legal teams drowning in volume, missing risk clauses and delaying deals.
Solution: AI reviews contracts in under 2 minutes, flags risky clauses, summarizes obligations, suggests redlines.
Differentiator: Trained on 10M+ enterprise contracts, integrates with DocuSign and Ironclad.
